description: Project one zero-based text column from callback rows in encounter order.

interface.semantic_input: Synchronous visitor-driven sequence of positioned, possibly ragged rows containing byte strings.
interface.semantic_output: One owned string per visited row, keeping selected bytes, order and repetition. Positions do not affect the output.

resources: Materializes the selected strings in an output vector. Peak memory and maximum row count are unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: The producer calls the supplied visitor synchronously while its borrowed row is valid. Each visited row needs a field at the zero-based index for successful completion.

postconditions.detail: Returns the selected bytes unchanged for every visited row in encounter order, preserving empty and repeated values on the frozen examples.

refinements.detail: Short rows threw std::out_of_range, including when a preceding row was valid. An empty producer returned an empty sequence even at the maximum tested size_t index.

effects.detail: The direct callable invoked the supplied producer and propagated its tested exception. On the ordinary TSV route, short rows and missing input stopped before the destination was created or replaced.

invariants.detail: Changing row positions, including repeated and negative positions, did not change visit order. Selected NUL, whitespace and multibyte bytes were preserved.

mathematical_properties.detail: The frozen cases returned a result vector with as many elements as successfully supplied rows when all selected fields existed.

formal_predicates.detail: The qualification provides finite observations and an ABI check. No formal proof was performed.

state_protocol.detail: The column visitor completed within one call in the tested synchronous producers. Calling it a second time reproduced the result or failure.

ownership.detail: The callable borrows the producer by reference and returns copies of selected strings by value. Mutating the original client rows after a call left the result intact.

concurrency.detail: Concurrency and asynchronous producer behavior were not tested.

upstream_usage.detail: The pinned project registration advertises one text column in original order. The pinned upstream test exercises the shared TSV reader.

specification_question.detail: Which zero-based column should be returned from every row?
